title: Yara and the Scholarship
author: Rafael Delacroix
blurb: Xanthe Eriksen, the new kid at a school built over something old, has spent twelve years being so careful it hurts. Then grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must save the tradition that made the town, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
